dominant: karuṇa with adbhuta weight (mourning worked into method; wonder at grace-laugh)
sthayibhava: śoka (grief for the dead) turned into bhakti through the rite
justification: The ahnika mourns — corpse rites, broken bells, death-causes — and each grief is worked; wonder at the laughing Lord and the meditated poison crowns the rite, and devotion answers scruple.
